title: English
description: ISC Class XI English: Paper 1 (English Language, 3 hours, 80 marks) and Paper 2 (Literature in English, 3 hours, 80 marks), plus internal assessment in speaking/listening.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - English (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Paper 1: language skills, comprehension, composition. Paper 2: drama, prose and poetry from prescribed texts.

sections.title: English Language (Paper 1)
sections.description: Composition, directed writing, grammar and comprehension skills.

chapters.title: Composition
chapters.blurb: Descriptive, narrative, argumentative and reflective essays; planning and drafting.

chapters.title: Directed Writing
chapters.blurb: Proposals, reports, speeches, articles and formal/informal letters to a given brief.

chapters.title: Grammar and Usage
chapters.blurb: Transformation, tense consistency, phrasal verbs, precision and error correction.

chapters.title: Comprehension
chapters.blurb: Unseen passages with inference, vocabulary in context and summary writing.

chapters.title: Literary Devices and Close Reading
chapters.blurb: Imagery, symbolism, irony, tone and figurative language applied to unseen and set texts. Prescribed drama, prose and poetry titles are pending verification against the official ISC list.
